item.title: Office of leadership, engagement director retires after 40 years at EIU
item.description: For four decades, Ceci Brinker served Eastern Illinois University as not only a coworker to her colleagues, but as a friend and role model to the campus community. item.title: Two seniors lead EIU OVC tournament win over SIUE

item.description: Eastern Illinois upset No. 5 seed SIUE 77-71 as the eighth seed in overtime last night at the Ford Center, getting head coach Marty Simmons his first career win in the Ohio Valley Conference Championship.
